reasons: Prerequisites for required courses (CS2103T, CS2105, CS3219, CS3230, CS2109S) cannot be met within the 8-semester limit given the 8 MC/semester cap and the requirement to take only 2 modules in Y1S1.

CS2103T requires CS2030/CS2030S/CS2030DE/CS2030HS and CS2040/CS2040S/CS2040C/CS2040DE/CS2040HS. With an 8 MC limit, completing these prerequisites plus other required courses is impossible before Y4S1.
CS3219 requires YSC3232 or CS2103/CS2103T/CS2103DE/CS2113T/CS2113. CS2103T itself has high prerequisites. The chain of dependencies cannot be resolved in time.
